guarantees: Observable metrics are represented separately from latent psychological mechanisms.
Observational outcomes cannot claim causality by default.
Randomized copy tests estimate the randomized intervention/bundle effect, not automatically a psychological mechanism.
Null, mixed, adverse and contradictory results are retained.
Campaign feedback updates bounded runtime/audience/channel/message hypotheses before scientific knowledge.
Scientific claims enter only as candidates and still require the research promotion lifecycle.
No fabricated experiment or campaign observation was inserted into live experiment/feedback registries during framework validation.
boundaries: Platform metric mappings remain context-specific and mostly unvalidated as latent-state measurements.
S7 provides learning discipline, not universal attribution of why a metric moved.
Runtime calibration parameters are architecture/empirical-operation parameters and must not be mislabeled as literature effect sizes.
